resources.string: LiMo is told which app is in front, by its name only, to count screen time and to cover an app when it is blocked or the time is used up. It is never told what is on the screen.
LiMo will stop itself from being removed without a parent. It asks for no other powers: it cannot wipe the phone, change the screen lock or use the camera. In this early build it does nothing yet.
How much screen time is left today.
A few minutes before the phone locks.
